hero_subtitle: BSc Computer Science Student & Software Developer
hero_intro: I engineer high-performance web applications, developer tools, and interactive digital experiences. Currently studying at the University of Bern.
joke_desc: Did you know? My first name "Jon" in UTF-8 hex is #4a6f6e — which is a beautiful slate green. Enter your name below to see your name as a hex color, and apply it to the site's theme!
proj_subtitle: A selection of open-source and professional tools I've engineered.
proj_xournal_desc: Concept and implementation of an open-source plugin for seamless integration of digital, handwritten Xournal++ notes (.xopp) in Obsidian via automated PDF export. Developed CI/CD workflow for testing, linting, and fully automated releases.
proj_xournal_impact: Lead Developer and Maintainer of a growing community with over 9,000+ installations.
proj_pulsemetrics_desc: High-availability uptime monitoring platform built with Next.js, Go, and AWS. Features instant alerting, status pages, and globally distributed health checks using Docker and Terraform.
proj_fatiguediary_desc: Comprehensive web tracker for patients with Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS). Features interactive energy-level analysis and data visualization. Over 400 registered users. Nominated for the best Matura thesis.
exp_subtitle: My professional history and freelance consulting roles.
exp_ta_desc: Led practice sessions, answered student questions, and graded assignments and exams for the computer science lectures 'Databases' and 'Foundations of Computer Engineering'.
exp_intern_desc: Worked on service provisioning via a web app for 'Garaio REM', the #1 Swiss real estate software, as part of a University of Bern practical project. Collaborated in an agile team, taking responsibility for planning and executing the testing concepts.
exp_freelance_desc: Developed custom responsive websites and e-commerce online shops for local businesses and private clients using SvelteKit and WordPress.
exp_tutor_desc: Provided private math tutoring for high school students (Gymnasium level) to prepare them for final exams.
edu_bsc_title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
edu_bsc_desc: Minors in Mathematics, Business Administration, and Digitalization & Applied Data Science. Current GPA: 5.7 / 6.0.

about_subtitle: My story, interests, and what drives me.
about_p1: I am an enthusiastic Computer Science student at the University of Bern with a deep passion for modern web development, Linux customizing, and developer productivity tools. I have a strong love for clean, linear history and definitely use git rebase -i way too often.
about_p2: In addition to software engineering, I have a strong foundation in mathematics and physics, which I enjoy sharing with others through tutoring. I am always looking for opportunities to collaborate on open-source projects or help local businesses establish their web presence.
about_hobby_web_desc: Building responsive interfaces and scalable web services using SvelteKit, React, and Go.
about_hobby_linux_desc: Tinkering with system dotfiles, tiling window managers, and scripting terminal automations.
about_hobby_climbing_desc: Staying active through indoor bouldering, sport climbing, and athletic gymnastics.
about_hobby_games_desc: Enjoying tactical card games and tabletop board game nights with friends.
